title: マイルCS南部杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, I know we were just talking a minute ago, but I figured I might as well write you guys a letter too… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I'm racing in Morioka today! And I even heard somebody calling me a homegrown star!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But then I met a friend from my old club (the one who cried her eyes out when I first went to Tokyo) and she said she was gonna quit running.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: She really loves running, but she doesn't think she has the talent… And to think, she used to say she was gonna come run in the centrals like me…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: So I made up my mind! As the Star of Morioka, I was gonna give a performance so dazzling, it reminded her how to dream!
